description: This file defines a function getTopInvoice that retrieves and displays a list of top invoices, including database queries, view rendering, and filtering logic within the context of the SugarCRM platform. It also contains a helper function getTopInvoiceSearch for setting search criteria.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: CustomView class used to handle custom view logic for the 'Invoice' module.

classes.name: QueryGenerator
classes.description: QueryGenerator class responsible for building database queries dynamically based on module and user inputs.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Controller class to manage list view rendering, headers, and entries.

classes.name: Invoice
classes.description: Model class representing an Invoice entity.

methods.name: getTopInvoice
methods.description: Retrieves a list of top invoices based on custom view and search criteria, manages pagination, and prepares data for display.

methods.name: getTopInvoiceSearch
methods.description: Sets up default search criteria for the invoice list, specifically filtering for 'Paid' status and current user assignment.
